name: [🔥🏹]🃏 Borderland
desc:
🃏 Welcome to Borderland! Inspired by the series Alice in Borderland.

🔥 Survive thrilling death games in this fun multiplayer experience!

🏃 SPRINT CONTROLS
PC: Left Shift
CONSOLE: L2

🎮 Games: Dead Or Alive (3♣), Tag (5♠), Hide and Seek (7♥), Osmosis (K♣), Solitary Confinement (J♥), Beauty Contest (K◆), Checkmate (Q♠), Boiling Death (7♠), Target (Q♣), Labyrinth (K♥), Distance (4♣), Battle Royale (J♠), Witch Hunt (10♥), Survival (K♠), Beamline (🃏), Sacred Fortunes (🃏), Zombie Hunt (🃏), Runaway Train (🃏), Kick The Can (🃏)

👍 Leave a thumbs up if you enjoyed the game!
